source: USDA NASS Cold Storage (monthly), end-of-month stocks in public, private and semi-private refrigerated warehouses; million lb. Fetched from USDA ESMIS release text files.

notes.index: 100 x value / trailing 12-month mean of the same series (trend-adjusted)
notes.pct_prod: 100 x stocks / carcass lb slaughtered in the month (LM_HG201 barrows and gilts, mandatory reporting)
notes.release: report for month M, released about the 22nd-25th of M, holds stocks at the end of M-1
